snippet.title: The Hag in White - A Fire Emblem fangame [OUT NOW]
snippet.description:

Music is as it appears in the hack. In order of appearance:
BGM 1 from Rondo of Swords
Pandemonic Planet from Touhou LoLK
Heroic Struggle from Live a Live
BGM 12 from Rondo of Swords
Pink Shell from Mother 3
Epic Poem to Sacred Death from Valkyrie Profile
